generations.name: First generation
generations.notes: Launch MY2027 (Performance Launch Package deliveries from spring 2026; EPA lists it as 2027). 87.9 kWh usable structural pack of cylindrical cells, 400 V; Rivian's first native NACS port; DC peak 217 kW per the EPA certification (Rivian quoted ~220, one outlet 240); 10-80% about 29 min. Canada deliveries said to start in 2027. Confidence: medium (researched 2026-11-19, owner review pending). Sources: https://jalopnik.com/2121494/2027-rivian-r2-launches-details-range-specs-pricing/ ; https://driveteslacanada.ca/news/rivian-officially-unveils-r2-specs-and-pricing-confirming-canada-deliveries-in-2027/ ; https://electrek.co/2026/06/09/rivian-r2-first-drive-this-is-everything-i-need-to-upgrade-my-model-y-except/
